text: Figure 7.27: Memory Usage. The resourceConsumption.memoryUsage is the amount of memory which can be allocated by the process itself. Please be aware, depending on the OS and its configuration this does not necessarily contain all the memory the process can allocate within the system. For example in an OS where common functionality like a file system is implemented on process level, the restricted process might still lead to memory allocations within the process providing the file system. On POSIX OS the memory limit is typically restricted by the resource RLIMIT_AS.
